author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the announcement trailer for The Royal Restoration Society, a tidying-up game developed by Dead Possum Games where you clean and redecorate an entire castle room by room. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Play solo or invite up to 3 of your friends to help you restore the once-regal Castle Marmosa. The Royal Restoration Society is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: The Royal Restoration Society - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the DMZ Worldbuilder trailer for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, the upcoming installment in the first-person action shooter franchise developed by Infinity Ward. Every corner of DMZ has a story to tell. Explore the world, follow the clues, and uncover more about what happened here and what’s still waiting to be discovered. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is launching on October 23 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Official DMZ Worldbuilder Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for LUCY, a dark 2D action-platformer for PC and mobile developed by CERKI GAMES. Join Lucy on a dangerous quest to rescue her friends. Wield your sword and venture through dark forests, treacherous caves, and lava-filled landscapes in this 2D action-platformer. LUCY is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: LUCY - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the first gameplay trailer for VCR83, a new surveillance psychological horror game where you observe and monitor strange happenings through security cameras, figuring out what happened during each shift in playable Aftermath sequences. Meanwhile, your friendly virtual assistant Pete becomes "increasingly involved" as the story progresses. Sounds a bit ominous... Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4668080/VCR83/
title: VCR83: Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Zombie Mode gameplay trailer for Red Light On, the hyper-realistic single-player first-person shooter developed by V Games. Players will embody a tactical officer investigating a case that goes awry. Fall back on combat tactics and utilize investigative abilities to seek the truth behind the case. Red Light On is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Red Light On - Official Zombie Mode Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Definitely Not A Chameleon, a chaotic 2-10 player hide-and-seek game developed by Identical Idea. Play as sneaky Chameleons, blending in and disguising themselves while hungry Snakes hunt them down. Hide smart, chase hard, and trust absolutely nothing! Definitely Not A Chameleon is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Definitely Not A Chameleon - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the launch trailer for Wizzo PopOut, a fast-paced, chaotic 3D top-down arena shooter developed by Die Wizzos. Wizzo PopOut combines high-speed movement and knockback with a unique spell-swapping  mechanic. Up to 4 players pick up 12 unique spells, combine them into custom loadouts, and swap them on the fly to adapt to the situation or for unpredictable chain combos. Wizzo PopOut is available now on PC (Steam).
title: Wizzo PopOut - Official Launch Trailer
